items.title: Which Restaurant Stock Is Dominating in 2026: McDonald’s, Chipotle, or Starbucks?
items.summary: One restaurant chain is trading at a sky-high valuation while another has shed double digits this year, and the market's verdict defies everything a shaky consumer economy would predict about which business wins.

items.title: Starbucks Is Reportedly Cutting 224 Jobs As Its $2B Cost Push Takes Shape — SBUX Stock Slips 1.5%
items.summary: Starbucks is reportedly eliminating 104 roles across store design and construction, while 120 Seattle-based workers face separation after declining to relocate to Nashville.

items.title: Starbucks Laying Off More Than 200 Workers in Streamlining Drive
items.summary: The cuts affect the company’s corporate staff in technology and coffeehouse development. The reductions don’t involve cafe closures.

items.title: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights McDonald's, Starbucks and Yum! Brands
items.summary: McDonald's, Starbucks and Yum! Brands are included in this Analyst Blog.

items.title: What Could Power The Next Rally In McDonald's Stock
items.summary: A new beverage platform running at or above plan in each market it has entered offers McDonald's stock its clearest evidenced path up from a base left by a year of underperformance.

items.title: A Big Risk In Coca-Cola Stock Is What Its Earnings Step-Up Is Made Of
items.summary: The stock has not been priced this richly against its own sales at any point in a decade, and part of the earnings growth that price pays for comes from an exchange-rate swing rather than from the operation.

items.title: McDonald's Stock Down 19% in 6 Months: Is This a Buying Opportunity?
items.summary: MCD's U.S. traffic weakness and execution issues weigh on the stock, but international growth, beverages and a recovery plan offer upside.

items.title: Can Starbucks' Solid Comps Growth Support Stronger FY26 Earnings?
items.summary: Can SBUX sustain its FY26 earnings momentum as strong comps, higher traffic and cost savings support further margin growth?
